summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding the issuance and sale of $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 7.250% Series A Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057. The notes were sold in a registered public offering under an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3. Interest is payable semi-annually at 7.250% until the First Reset Date on February 15, 2032, after which it resets to the Five-year U.S. Treasury Rate plus 2.889% with a 7.250% floor. The notes are subordinated unsecured obligations, guaranteed by Alexandria Real Estate Equities, L.P., and mature on February 15, 2057. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
